name: Eliathis Delivery Zones and Pickup for WooCommerce
author: eliakimkassi

sections.description:
Eliathis Delivery Zones and Pickup adds a “delivery mode / delivery zone” block to the WooCommerce checkout (Checkout Block and classic checkout shortcode).

  • Delivery zones with their own price and currency, grouped by category (up to 10 in the free plugin).
  • Three ways of receiving orders, each one can be switched on or off: home delivery, on-site pickup and pickup by a third party (name and phone of the person collecting the order).
  • Adapted to your activity: answer a few questions in Eliathis › Personalise (restaurant, store, pharmacy, garage… or your own activity) and the checkout speaks your words: “Your store”, “Please choose your pharmacy”…
  • Ordering hours: same hours every day or per day of the week. Outside those hours the checkout is blocked on the server side, not only in the browser.
  • Optional site-wide “closing soon” popup with a live countdown, a call-to-action button and a banner in the mini cart; order buttons are disabled automatically once the store is closed.
  • Delivery details saved in the order and shown in the order screen, in the emails and in the customer account.
  • Interface in English, with a French translation included (regional variants such as fr_CA or fr_BE use it too).
  • Compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) and the Checkout Block.

An optional Eliathis Delivery Pro add-on brings several stores, unlimited delivery zones, custom texts and colors with a live preview, import/export of zones and points of sale, integration with OrderFlow Manager, roles and rights for the team, an activity log, delivery reports, automatic routing, scheduled orders, a reopening alert and a tracking link with QR code for third-party pickup.

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by WooCommerce or Automattic.

Source code

All JavaScript and CSS files are shipped unminified, as written: there is no build step.

About Eliathis

Developed by Eliathis: Saint-Pierre Kassi and Mathis Alapini.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the eliathis-delivery-zones-pickup folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip from Plugins › Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin (WooCommerce must be active).
  3. Go to WooCommerce › Settings › Shipping, open a shipping zone and add the Eliathis Delivery Zones and Pickup shipping method.
  4. Configure your store, delivery zones, prices and ordering hours in Eliathis › Delivery & pickup (also linked from the shipping method settings).
sections.faq:
Does the plugin work without WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce is required; a notice is shown in the administration if it is not active.

Does it support the classic checkout shortcode?

Yes, both the Checkout Block and the classic [woocommerce_checkout] shortcode are supported.

I used the previous version named “Delivery Logistics”.

Deactivate “Delivery Logistics” and activate this plugin: its settings and the shipping method of your shipping zones are taken over automatically. Previous orders keep their delivery details.
sections.changelog:
2.6.11

  • Visual fix: the primary button had no real hover state (no color change, no transition); plain links and the rows of the stores/zones/currencies tables didn’t react on hover either. Added: hover, a pressed state, a keyboard focus ring and smooth transitions on every button; color and underline on hover for links; a tinted background on hover for table rows.

2.6.10

  • Important fix: $_GET['page'] was never set inside the Eliathis space (pretty URL, no ?page= query string), and many plugins use it to decide what to enqueue or display — a page could show up completely bare in the space while it looks polished in wp-admin. The space now sets $_GET['page']/$_REQUEST['page'] to the page being shown, like a real admin.php?page=… URL.

2.6.9

  • Shared hub module 1.9.7: the “Eliathis” wp-admin sidebar menu — until now completely plain, no icon at all — now shows an icon in front of every entry (Home, Personalise, Delivery & pickup…), with an indigo accent on hover and on the active one.

2.6.8

  • Shared hub module 1.9.6: the Home, Personalise and Licences pages now show the same entrance animations as the /eliathis/ space (motion.dev), viewed directly in wp-admin.

2.6.7

  • New: entrance animations on the settings page (hero, cards), a gentle hover lift and a pulsing ring on the hero logo — same vendored animation library already used by the shared space (motion.dev, its own copy in eliathis-hub/vendor/motion.min.js). Respects reduced-motion.

2.6.6

  • Fixed: extension pages inside the Eliathis space only loaded their own CSS/JS (fixed in 2.6.5), never wp-admin’s own base stylesheet (.button, .notice, .form-table, list tables…) — readable but with none of wp-admin’s own look. The space now loads the same wp-admin stylesheet (plus buttons) that wp-admin/admin-header.php loads on every real admin page. Shared hub module 1.9.5.

2.6.5

  • Fixed: after the 2.6.4 fix, extension pages displayed inside the Eliathis space (/eliathis/<page>/) with no styling at all — only the shared hub module’s own CSS/JS were printed, never the extension’s own enqueued assets. The space now prints the whole queue, including whatever the displayed extension itself enqueued. Shared hub module 1.9.4.

2.6.4

  • Fixed: after the 2.6.3 fix, extension pages showed blank in the Eliathis space (/eliathis/<page>/) instead of their content — a plugin only registers its page content when admin_menu fires, a hook that never fires on the front end. The space now fires it itself before showing the page. Shared hub module 1.9.3.

2.6.3

  • Fixed: the 2.6.2 fix only covered part of the critical error. load-… and admin_enqueue_scripts are global hooks fired for every active plugin on the site, not just this one, and any of them could still crash the whole site. Each call is now individually guarded (try/catch): a misbehaving third-party plugin can no longer bring the whole site down, a clear message is shown instead. The “Manage” button on the Home card now always opens the Eliathis space, never wp-admin. Shared hub module 1.9.2.

2.6.2

  • Fixed: opening a plugin’s own page from the Eliathis space (/eliathis/<page>/) could trigger a site-wide critical error (set_current_screen() broadcast an action other active plugins did not expect outside wp-admin). Shared hub module 1.9.1.

2.6.1

  • Fixed: saving any settings section from the Eliathis space (/eliathis/) no longer bounces back to wp-admin afterwards.

2.6.0

  • This free plugin now manages a single store (its name, address, phone and email), with fixed default checkout texts and colors, manual entry of zones (no import/export) and a simple schedule (no overnight ranges). An optional “Eliathis Delivery Pro” add-on brings back several stores (manual entry or from OrderFlow Manager), custom texts and colors with a live preview, import/export, overnight and per-store hours, roles and rights for the team, an activity log and delivery reports.
  • The checkout no longer asks the customer to choose a store when there is only one: it is filled in automatically.
  • The delivery zones table is now paginated (5, 10, 15 or 20 per page) and limited to 10 zones in the free plugin; Eliathis Delivery Pro removes this limit.
  • Spanish and German translations are no longer updated (removed from the description; the files already shipped are kept as is). English and French stay up to date.

2.5.0

  • Export: the current zones and the points of sale entered by hand can be downloaded as Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, with the same columns as the import model, so the file can be changed and imported again.
  • Import models: blank model (columns only) or model with examples, as Excel or CSV.
  • Fix: a cart with nothing to deliver (virtual products such as licences, gift cards or services) no longer asks for a point of sale, a reception mode or a zone, and is never refused or cancelled by the delivery rules.
  • Fix: on a store without shipping method in its zones, the classic checkout fields are shown when a product must be delivered (they were hidden but still required).
  • Settings of the former Delivery Logistics plugin are taken over again when they change (for example after a backup is imported), after a backup copy of the current settings.

2.4.0

  • Spanish (es_ES) and German (de_DE) translations included, in addition to French. Regional variants (es_MX, es_AR, de_AT, de_CH, fr_BE, fr_CA…) use the main language of their family.
  • Shared Eliathis module 1.5.0.

2.3.1

  • Eliathis home page: the “You can also install” section only lists the Eliathis extensions already published on WordPress.org.

2.3.0

  • Each section of the settings page (general, points of sale, texts, hours, currencies, zones, colours) is saved on its own, with its own button; unsaved changes are flagged.
  • Import of delivery zones and points of sale from an Excel (.xlsx, .xlsm) or CSV file, with a downloadable model (add / update, or replace all).
  • Points of sale can come automatically from OrderFlow Manager when it is active.
  • Live preview of the colours and texts, before saving.
  • Neutral colours for the settings page and for the default checkout colours (saved colours are kept).

2.2.0

  • Checkout texts adapted to your activity (Eliathis › Personalise): “Your store”, “Please choose your restaurant”, “Store & delivery options”… instead of texts written for restaurants. Texts you changed by hand are kept.
  • Home delivery and on-site pickup can now be switched off, like third-party pickup; a disabled option is also refused on the server side.
  • “In-store pickup” renamed “On-site pickup”.
  • Eliathis home page: an extension without the Eliathis menu is shown as “Older version”, with a clearer explanation.

2.1.0

  • Settings page moved from the WooCommerce menu to the shared Eliathis menu (same address: admin.php?page=eliathis-delivery-zones-pickup), with an Eliathis home page listing the Eliathis plugins.
  • Link to the settings from the shipping method and from the plugins list.
  • Interface texts in English, French translation (fr_FR) included in the languages folder.
  • Default settings now follow the site language.

2.0.0

  • New name: Eliathis Delivery Zones and Pickup for WooCommerce (previously “Delivery Logistics”), new slug and text domain eliathis-delivery-zones-pickup.
  • Every function, class, constant, option, session key, order meta, script handle, JavaScript object and CSS class now uses the unique edzp prefix.
  • Automatic migration from “Delivery Logistics” 1.x: settings and shipping zone methods are taken over; previous orders are still displayed.
  • The checkout script is shipped as readable source (no minified file).
  • Generic default settings (no sample store names).

1.9.2

  • Countdown badge no longer added to compact (icon-only) order buttons.

1.9.1

  • Default “closing soon” threshold set to 45 minutes; countdown badge and pulse on every order button of the site.

1.9.0

  • Redesigned hours popup, automatic disabling of order buttons while closed, mini cart banner.

1.8.0

  • Site-wide popup when the store is closed or about to close.

1.7.0

  • Ordering hours per day of the week.

1.6.0

  • Orders can no longer be placed without an explicit store, delivery mode and zone.

1.5.0

  • Multi-store support: each delivery zone belongs to a store.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
